name: Waifu Seikatsu ~Oku-sama wa Chijo~
source:
Choose the clothing and dialog to seduce men!
You are a married woman who has a desire to sleep with a lot of men.
Control her action and choose a man from a map.
Does she succeed in getting the pleasure or does she fail and ruin her married life?
All is up to you!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050607.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
选择服装与对话，勾引男人！
你是一名渴望与众多男人上床的已婚女性。
控制她的行动，从地图上挑选目标。
她能否得偿所愿、享受快感，还是会落得失败收场，毁掉自己的婚姻？
一切都由你决定！

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050607.html]DLsite English[/url]]
